welcome_offer.description: Limited-time offer: earn up to 75,000 World of Hyatt bonus points: 45,000 bonus points after spending $5,000 in the first 3 months from account opening, plus up to 30,000 more bonus points by earning 2 bonus points total per $1 on purchases that normally earn 1 point per $1, on up to $15,000 spent in the first 6 months.
notes: Chase issuer page verified 2026-08-19: 45,000 points after $5,000/3mo plus up to 30,000 points through temporary extra earning on up to $15,000 in the first 6 months.
Issuer page labels the offer ending soon; approved offer-watch report records 2026-08-20 as the expiry date.
